page_title: AST 3-1 BOU | Aston Villa v Bournemouth 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' It will be a substitution. Kaine Kesler Hayden (Aston Villa) is ready to enter the pitch as Matty Cash walks off.
90+5' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

90+4' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) is put clear inside the box by a lofted pass. He only has the keeper to beat, but Emiliano Martinez comes out bravely to save at his feet. Great goalkeeping skills! The ball goes behind for a corner. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
90+3' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Moussa Diaby departs the field of play to be replaced by Jhon Duran (Aston Villa).
90+3' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
90+2' Bournemouth control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
90+1' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
89' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
87' Here comes a substitution. Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Leon Bailey.
87' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) infringed the rules and goes into the book. Tim Robinson pulls out a yellow card.
85' A pass by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
83' Enes Unal (Bournemouth) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
82' Andoni Iraola has decided to make a change. Enes Unal (Bournemouth) replaces Dango Ouattara.
82' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is penalised for a foul. Tim Robinson had a clear view and blows his whistle.
81' The Bournemouth players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
78' 3 - 1 Goal! Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) finishes from close range with an easy finish and he makes it 3:1. He was ably assisted there by Ollie Watkins.
76' Leon Bailey picks out Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), who drives a shot just wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
76' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) and he is replaced by Alex Scott.
76' Today's match ends for Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) who will be replaced by Philip Billing.
74' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) launches a cross from the corner, but Neto is alert to thwart the effort.
74' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) is thwarted and cleared to safety. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Aston Villa.
73' Surely that's handball by one of the Bournemouth players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
72' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
70' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) wins the ball in the box, but curls his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
70' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
69' A cross from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
69' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner with a short pass.
69' An attempted cross from Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) is cleared. The ball goes out for a corner. Aston Villa can continue in their attacking effort.
68' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

68' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort. Aston Villa force their opponents to concede a corner.
68' The ball goes out of play. Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.

68' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Aston Villa.
65' The corner from Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is intercepted by Neto.
65' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
64' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marcos Senesi trots off the pitch and is replaced by Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth).
64' Emiliano Martinez makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the top left corner by Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) after a cross from the side.
60' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
60' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
57' 2 - 1 Goal! Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from Ollie Watkins, then sends the ball into the bottom right corner. 2:1.
55' Tim Robinson shows a yellow card to Ilya Zabarnyi (Bournemouth) for his blatant foul.
55' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Emiliano Martinez intercepts the ball.
55' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
52' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Neto is equal to the effort and makes a good save.

51' A through ball from Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) fails to reach Dominic Solanke as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Dominic Solanke could have got into a promising position.
50' The Aston Villa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
48' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
47' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
46' The game is over for Adam Smith. Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) comes on for the second half.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+6' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+5' John McGinn (Aston Villa) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
45+4' Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) sends a screamer well wide of the right post from the edge of the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
45+1' 1 - 1 That was a nice piece of skill by Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa)! He skips past a few defenders and manages to fire a superb effort that goes into the top right corner. The score is 1:1.
45+1' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
44' The resulting set piece from Aston Villa is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

44' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Corner kick. Aston Villa will have an opportunity.
42' That's a well played offside trap. Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) is flagged for offside, ending the attack.
41' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the right post.
39' Bournemouth fail to score from a corner as Emiliano Martinez (Aston Villa) leaps to collect the ball.

39' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bournemouth are going to take it.
39' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
37' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Tim Robinson didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
37' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

37' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players. It will be a corner kick for Bournemouth.
34' Tim Robinson blows his whistle as Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
33' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
31' 0 - 1 Goal! Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Emiliano Martinez into the top left corner.
30' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) is going to take the penalty!
28' Poor challenge! Matty Cash (Aston Villa) is penalised for tripping and Tim Robinson blows his whistle. PENALTY to Bournemouth!
27' Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post.
25' Dango Ouattara (Bournemouth) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.

23' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) doesn't hesitate to shoot inside the box after a neat pass from Leon Bailey. It's a good effort but just misses the left post. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
23' Neto is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from John McGinn (Aston Villa). Easy save!
22' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
22' A pass by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
21' Caution goes to Adam Smith (Bournemouth).
19' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty as the referee indicates there was no infringement.
18' There's a break in play and referee Tim Robinson must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Bournemouth using VAR. This could be interesting!
18' Surely that's handball by one of the Aston Villa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
17' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) outjumped his marker after a well-taken corner, but his header goes wide of the target.
17' Bournemouth have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

16' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the roof of the net, but Emiliano Martinez earns his money with a fine reflex save. The ball is out of play. Bournemouth win a corner kick.
15' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
14' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
13' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Pau Torres.
12' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
11' Matty Cash (Aston Villa) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
10' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) commits a foul and Tim Robinson immediately signals a free kick.
8' Flag up against Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
5' John McGinn (Aston Villa) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
5' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) takes it short.
5' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. Aston Villa win a corner.
2' The ball is cleared after Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Bournemouth will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tim Robinson.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
